summary: US tariff stack on Chinese goods changed in 2026: the Supreme Court invalidated IEEPA tariffs (Feb 2026), a temporary 10% Section 122 tariff expired Jul 24, and was replaced by a flat 12.5% Section 301 forced-labor duty on top of the legacy 7.5%/25% Section 301 lists. Demand signals this fall point to beauty/scalp care, sleep and recovery wellness, pet enrichment and pet tech, cozy-home items, and giftable electronics heading into Q4. Evidence quality is mixed: most trend and cost data comes from secondary blogs and aggregators (Amazon, Reddit and Google Trends could not be fetched directly), so every unit cost is an estimate to be confirmed with supplier quotes.
changes_vs_last_run: First run. No previous run to compare against.

candidates.name: Hard water shower filter head with 2 spare cartridges (vitamin C/KDF)
fixable_complaints: cartridge lasts only about a month
candidates.angle: Sell a lightweight head with a longer-life cartridge and a refill pack (o-ring included), and state real cartridge lifespan.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Do not claim it treats skin conditions or eczema (drug claim). Water-treatment filtration claims (chlorine reduction) may need NSF/ANSI 177 testing to be stated; use 'filters' language only without certification. Standard Amazon category, no gating known.
candidates.notes: Duty is an estimate (~3% MFN + 25% legacy 301 + 12.5% new 301 assumed); HTS not verified. Unit cost is a guess, not a quote. Orders/customer 1.5 assumes ~half of buyers reorder cartridges in 12 months. Search interest reported +21% YoY (~37K/mo); market-size figures in sources conflict widely. Complaints come from reseller pages, not Amazon.

candidates.name: Pet enrichment bundle: silicone lick mat + fabric snuffle mat + slow feeder bowl
candidates.angle: Bundle three items with dishwasher-safe food-grade silicone and a feeding guide, rather than one commodity mat.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Food-contact silicone: ask supplier for FDA LFGB/FDA food-grade test report. Pet products are not CPSIA children's products. State-level pet product labeling is minimal.
candidates.notes: Single lick mats retail ~$16 and wholesale as low as ~$5.5 (unverified aggregator), so the bundle is needed to clear ~$40/customer. Unit cost is a conservative guess. Pet enrichment flagged as growth niche by seller blogs; no hard numbers.

candidates.name: Cordless wireless-pump pet water fountain, 2.5L, quiet motor
fixable_complaints: pump stopped working after about 3 months
sensor triggers whenever someone walks by
candidates.angle: Use a replaceable sealed pump with 12-month warranty and a less sensitive sensor, and sell filters as a subscription.
candidates.regulatory_notes: FCC Part 15 for the electronics/sensor; USB-C battery needs UN38.3 and Amazon lithium battery (dangerous goods) review. Pet product, no CPSIA.
candidates.notes: Cost and freight are estimates. Orders/customer 1.3 from filter refills. Complaints from Catster review and Trustpilot, small sample. Fountain with battery may need hazmat classification in FBA.

candidates.name: Full-face LED red light therapy mask (wellness positioning), rechargeable
candidates.angle: Offer a verifiable FDA 510(k)-cleared OEM unit with honest claims, better fit and clear LED spec sheet.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Anti-wrinkle/acne claims make it an FDA Class II device needing 510(k) clearance; only sell with a verifiable clearance number from the FDA database, or market for general wellness with no medical claims. FCC and UN38.3 battery testing. Eye safety IEC 62471 test report advisable.
candidates.notes: Global Sources shows ~$36-45 at MOQ 500 and Beautetrade $129 FOB at 100 units; I used $40. Heavy competition from big brands (so competition score low). Retail page 'FDA-certified' claims are unverified.

candidates.name: 3-in-1 Qi2 magnetic foldable wireless charging station (phone, watch, earbuds)
candidates.angle: Use real Qi2 certified module with better heat dissipation and a strong magnet ring, and state compatibility clearly.
candidates.regulatory_notes: FCC authorization (verify FCC ID in FCC database), Qi2 certification via WPC for the logo, UL/ETL for the adapter; Amazon requires safety documentation for chargers.
candidates.notes: Alibaba listings range $0.99-$15; the $0.99 one is implausible, so I used a $14 mid-range cost. Retail comparables $49.99 (RayCue). Heat and magnet strength are noted as main end-user concerns in Alibaba reports (vendor sourced).

candidates.name: Wax melt warmer lamp with dimmer plus starter wax melts
candidates.angle: Bundle a no-spill ceramic dish lamp with replaceable bulb and a refill wax subscription.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Plug-in heated appliance: UL/ETL listing expected by Amazon and retailers; CPSC electrical rules. Fragrance products: label allergens, no hazmat when wax is solid but check SDS for FBA.
candidates.notes: Alibaba lamp-style warmers ~$5.39-$10.98 at small MOQs; Amazon retail $11-$39. Cost includes wax melts (guess). Orders/customer 1.5 assumes wax refills. Seasonal Q4 skew.

candidates.name: Smart portable mini projector 1080p with WiFi casting
candidates.angle: Honest lumen/native-resolution specs, quieter fan, and a short setup guide to cut returns.
candidates.regulatory_notes: FCC Part 15 plus WiFi/Bluetooth module certification; lithium battery if built-in (UN38.3); Netflix/Disney casting licensing issues if claiming apps.
candidates.notes: Top sellers estimated 7-10K units/month at $38-$140 average ~$108 (third-party estimates). Wholesale price not found; $45 is my guess. Cheapest units have high return risk per Havit guide.

candidates.name: Rosemary + peptide scalp and hair serum 60ml (cosmetic, private label)
candidates.angle: Lightweight non-greasy formula in a leak-proof pump or roller bottle with a 90-day routine card.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic under MoCRA: facility registration and product listing (small business exemption under $1M avg US cosmetic sales), safety substantiation, ingredient labeling, adverse event reporting. Do not claim hair growth/regrowth or treating hair loss (drug claim). Amazon Beauty may require approval.
candidates.notes: Cosmetics Business cites +395% Google searches over 12 months and 12.3M TikTok views for rosemary hair oil (article date unclear); Mielle rosemary oil ~40-50K monthly sales (ASINsight). Mature top brands, so competition is moderate-hard. Cost $3-$15 range per sources; used $6. Orders/customer 2.0 is conservative for ~2-month supply. Setup fees $1.5-6K not included.

candidates.name: Vitamin C + niacinamide brightening face serum 30ml (private label)
candidates.angle: Airless pump packaging with stabilized vitamin C derivative to stop oxidation.
candidates.regulatory_notes: MoCRA facility registration/listing (or small business exemption), ingredient labeling; avoid 'repairs collagen' or acne treatment claims. Amazon Beauty category approval may be needed.
candidates.notes: Mentioned as TikTok Shop top US seller in coverage. Very crowded; competition score low. Cost per guides $3-$15; used $6 including packaging. Repeat rate assumed low-ish.

candidates.name: Magnesium glycinate gummies, 60-count bottle (supplement, private label)
candidates.angle: Sugar-free, third-party tested with transparent label and 30-day supply per bottle.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Dietary supplement: cGMP (21 CFR 111) via a compliant contract manufacturer, Supplement Facts label, FDA structure/function claims only with disclaimer, no disease claims, adverse event reporting. FDA facility registration by the manufacturer. Amazon supplements category is gated (requires third-party testing/GMP docs).
candidates.notes: Supplier listings show $1.78-$2.49 per piece (unclear if per bottle); I used $6 as a conservative bottle cost incl. packaging, a guess. Heavy incumbents; DSHEA/FDA primary sources not retrieved. Orders/customer 2.0 conservative for 30-day supply.

candidates.name: Cordless heated neck and shoulder massager (EMS/kneading)
candidates.angle: Lighter design with a larger battery and tested heat levels.
candidates.regulatory_notes: FCC Part 15, UN38.3 lithium battery, avoid medical/pain-treatment claims (EMS may be FDA-regulated TENS device). Keep claims to 'relaxing massage'.
candidates.notes: Neck/shoulder massagers named a TikTok Shop staple in coverage. Cost is estimated, not quoted. EMS feature would raise FDA risk; drop it if unsure.

candidates.name: Microwavable weighted neck wrap + eye mask gift set
candidates.angle: Double-stitched flax-filled pockets and gift box with heating instructions.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Not a medical claim product; avoid 'pain relief' claims. Labeling for textile fiber content (Textile Act) and heating instructions; no CPSIA unless marketed to kids.
candidates.notes: Retail anchors: $22.49 eye mask (Staples), $16-23 US promo neck wraps; factory cost unquoted (guess $5.50). Orders/customer 1.2 mostly gifting. Weaker trend evidence.

candidates.name: Cooling weighted blanket 15 lb, 60x80
candidates.angle: Small baffle boxes to stop bead shift, glass beads, honest weight tolerance.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Textile labeling (RN/fiber content), California TB117/law label for bedding; flammability for mattress items not applicable to blankets generally. No CPSIA unless children's size.
candidates.notes: Amazon prices tracked $24.99-$49.73 for 10-20 lb blankets, so price pressure is high. The Global Sources $4.56-$6.76 prices look too low for real weighted blankets and were not used; $22 cost is my guess. Oversize fee guess $8.5. Possibly unprofitable after CPC.

candidates.name: 40oz insulated stainless tumbler with handle and straw lid (original design, no logos)
candidates.angle: Leak-tested lid, durable powder coat and color/bundle sets for gifts.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Food-contact stainless: FDA LFGB test report; California Prop 65 lead warning for lids/paint; don't copy Stanley's design patent or trade dress.
candidates.notes: Cost is a guess ($6.50); the US supplier price I found was $12-23 at small quantities, so factory cost uncertain. Orders/customer 1.5 from gifting and color collectors. Lid leak complaint is assumed from category, not found in my sources, so complaint_score is low confidence.

candidates.name: USB-C rechargeable portable blender with leakproof seal
candidates.angle: Better sealing ring, replaceable parts and an honest 'ice-ready' battery spec.
candidates.regulatory_notes: UN38.3 lithium battery test report and Amazon hazmat review, FDA food-contact materials, FCC Part 15.
candidates.notes: Complaint themes from manufacturer FAQ and repair blogs, not Reddit (blocked). Trend score low: mature gadget with weak 2026 evidence. Cost guessed.

candidates.name: Premium press-on nail kit (24 nails x several sets, glue and prep kit)
fixable_complaints: nails pop off in a day
candidates.angle: Better size range, stronger adhesive tabs and clear fit guide.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Cosmetic: MoCRA listing/exemption, adhesives need ingredient labels (watch for banned monomers like MMA); nail glue cyanoacrylate small bottle shipping rules.
candidates.notes: Wholesale cost found: $0.20-$1.50 per set, $0.55 on one Accio report; I used $1.80 for kit with glue. Revenue/customer ~ $41 depends on 2.3 orders, which is optimistic; borderline versus the $40 target.

candidates.name: Satin sleep bonnet + silk pillowcase set
candidates.angle: Adjustable wide-band bonnet in more sizes with matching pillowcase.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Textile fiber content labeling and care labels (FTC); no special approval beyond that.
candidates.notes: Retail comps: $9.49 bonnet, $2.88-$10.99 pillowcases. Price per bundle may face downward pressure; wholesale cost is a guess. Orders/customer 1.7 from gifting and color repeat.

candidates.name: Layered necklace set (hypoallergenic stainless steel, gold PVD)
candidates.angle: Waterproof PVD plating, anti-tangle spacing and gift box.
candidates.regulatory_notes: FTC jewelry guides for metal claims, Prop 65 lead/cadmium; CPSIA applies if marketed to kids under 12. Amazon Jewelry category has approval requirements.
candidates.notes: Alibaba reports layered-necklace buyers +858% YoY (small base, vendor data). Cost is a guess; unit price drops fast. $40 per customer relies on 1.6 orders (optimistic gift repeat).

candidates.name: Self-cleaning automatic cat litter box (budget tier)
candidates.angle: Dependable sensor and quiet motor at a price below Litter-Robot.
candidates.regulatory_notes: FCC Part 15 + WiFi/BLE certifications, UL/ETL for the power supply, Amazon pet electronics safety documents.
candidates.notes: One TikTok Shop item reportedly did ~$13M in Q4 2025 sales. Factory cost, freight and fulfillment are guesses; large oversize FBA fees. High CPC risk for a $180 item; returns risk.

candidates.name: Under-desk folding walking pad treadmill 2.5HP with remote
candidates.angle: Quiet motor and sturdy belt with a 1-year warranty.
candidates.regulatory_notes: FCC Part 15; UL certification for the power supply; no CPSIA. Amazon requires safety documentation for electric fitness equipment.
candidates.notes: Amazon pricing seen: $79.99-$236.99 depending on model; $149.99 is hard to defend as retail is as low as $80-90, so margin is probably thin. Cost/freight/fee are guesses. Trend direction not confirmed beyond many brands listing.

candidates.name: Fleece-lined thermal leggings (women's, 3 colors)
candidates.angle: Better size chart, opaque fabric and a no-roll waistband.
candidates.regulatory_notes: FTC textile and care labeling, flammability standard 16 CFR 1610, Prop 65, Amazon clothing category approval for some brands.
candidates.notes: One legging reportedly earned over half its lifetime TikTok sales in Q4 2025 (seasonal). Apparel duty HTS not verified; 0.35 assumed (MFN ~14% + 301 + 12.5%). High return rates for sizing. Strong seasonal spike.

candidates.name: Kids' craft and activity kit (e.g., bracelet or art kit) with gift box
candidates.angle: Complete kit with spare parts, clear step cards and gift packaging.
candidates.regulatory_notes: CPSIA: third-party testing by a CPSC-accepted lab, Children's Product Certificate (free to write, but testing costs roughly $500-3,000+ per item), ASTM F963, small parts/choking-hazard labeling, tracking labels, lead/phthalates limits.
candidates.notes: Testing cost estimates come from a seller blog (unverified). Testing is a fixed cost not included in inputs. Orders/customer 1.4 from gifting repeat.

candidates.name: Family card/board game with quality components
candidates.angle: Linen-finish cards, clear rules and gift-ready box.
candidates.regulatory_notes: If marketed to children under 12: CPSIA testing and CPC, ASTM F963, age grading and small parts warnings.
candidates.notes: Family games listed as a TikTok gift category in coverage; weak trend data and need an original design (IP risk). Costs guessed. Lowest confidence candidate.

candidates.name: Hydrocolloid pimple patch multipack (120 patches, 3 sizes)
candidates.angle: Better adhesion and a mixed shape pack; sell larger count for value.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Claims of treating acne can make this an OTC drug; sell as 'blemish cover' with cosmetic-only claims or use an OTC monograph-compliant manufacturer (e.g., salicylic acid patches are drugs). MoCRA registration/listing may apply.
candidates.notes: Retail benchmark: 330-count at ~$8, Hero 72-count ~$16-21. Dominated by Hero (huge reviews). 2.4 orders is optimistic; borderline vs. $40 target. Cost is a guess.

candidates.name: Mushroom coffee blend (lion's mane/chaga), 30 servings
candidates.angle: Clear extract ratios, better taste and sample sachet.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Food: FDA facility registration and prior notice for imports, nutrition label; functional claims limited (no disease claims); lion's mane/other mushroom ingredient claims may be treated as supplements. Better to manufacture in the US with a co-packer.
candidates.notes: Appears in Hostinger's wellness trend list. Cost is a guess from supplement-like blending; duty for food items differs by HTS and China-origin food adds extra risk. No quote retrieved. Low confidence.

candidates.name: Compact HEPA desktop/bedroom air purifier
candidates.angle: Honest CADR rating, quiet motor and cheap filter subscription.
candidates.regulatory_notes: California CARB ozone-emission certification, FCC Part 15, UL/ETL, AHAM CADR verification for claims; no health or virus-killing claims (FIFRA pesticide device rules).
candidates.notes: Included in Hostinger and Dokan trend lists. Cost guessed. Orders/customer 1.2 from filter sales.

candidates.name: 20,000mAh USB-C fast-charge power bank with built-in cable
candidates.angle: Tested true capacity, replaceable cable and airline-safe label.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Lithium batteries: UN38.3, MSDS, Amazon dangerous-goods (hazmat) approval, FCC, UL 2056/UL 62368; air freight is restricted so usually sea shipping.
candidates.notes: Listed in Dokan and Hostinger trend lists. Dominated by Anker (competition 1). Cost, hazmat fees are guesses; hazmat fulfillment may be higher.

candidates.name: Orthopedic calming dog bed, washable, medium/large
candidates.angle: Higher-density foam, removable washable cover and size guide.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Textile labeling; California TB117-2013 labeling for upholstered pet bedding in some states; Prop 65.
candidates.notes: Pet beds appear on TikTok gift list; pet products growing per Printify. Costs and freight guessed. Dominated by Furhaven/BarksBar.

candidates.name: Extra-thick non-slip yoga/exercise mat 6mm with strap
candidates.angle: TPE or natural rubber with odor-free finish and grip tested.
candidates.regulatory_notes: Prop 65, phthalate-free statement; no CPSIA unless marketed to kids; Amazon product safety documentation optional.
candidates.notes: Shopify notes yoga mats search peaks around January and rebounds toward year-end; steady not hot trend. Cost guessed. A lot of low-priced competitors.

candidates.name: Research peptides (BPC-157, retatrutide, semaglutide) sold 'for research use only'
candidates.kill_reason: Unapproved drugs / 'research use only' chemicals cannot legally be sold to US consumers for human use.
candidates.angle: n/a
candidates.regulatory_notes: Unapproved new drugs under FDCA.
candidates.notes: Rejected from general knowledge, not researched this run; no source retrieved.

candidates.kill_reason: Counterfeit/trademark and design-patent infringement of a brand.

candidates.regulatory_notes: Original-design tumbler is kept as a separate candidate.
